artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow inflatable figure has a slightly smeared, plastic-like texture that lacks fine surface detail, typical of AI generation struggling with complex inflated materials under low light.
The crowd heads merge into a uniform, repetitive texture without distinct individual features, suggesting generative smoothing rather than optical depth-of-field blur.
The ornate metalwork on the right vertical support seems to blend indistinctly into the background darkness and light flares, lacking clear structural connectivity at the base.
